newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Deutsche Telekom links with Manila firm.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom links with Manila firm.

text.p: Philippine telecom firm Isla Communications Co Inc (Islacom) has forged a partnership agreement with German telecoms giant Deutsche Telecom AG, the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) said on Sunday.
"Deutsche, now Islacom's major partner, is infusing not only technology but also equity," NTC Commissioner Simeon Kintanar told Reuters in a telephone interview.

Kintanar said he witnessed the signing of the agreement on Wednesday by top officials of Islacom, Deutsche and Thailand-based Shinawatra Computer and Communication Public Co Ltd. Islacom is an affiliate of Shinawatra.
Kintanar could not say if Shinawatra's 30 percent share in Islacom would be diluted with the entry of Deutsche.
He said the signing was kept low key as a ceremonial signing would take place during the visit of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl to Manila in October.
Officials of Islacom were unavailable for comment.
